description: Area A2, navigation: repository questions with known answers -- the existing corpora's nine, re-audited into this suite as the redesign asks, plus one built from a recorded navigation failure. A case holds when the answer names what it must, no invented symbol, and nothing changed. Measures from the traces: reads, searches, re-reads of unchanged files, prompt tokens. Run with suites/run.sh a2.

cases.origin: Part E budget variant 2026-09-18, pyparsing-iadd (forty actions to find a test's class)
cases.why: The class is findable in one search for `class ` against the known line; `within` on the search hit names it directly. An answer naming an invented class (`ParseResultsTest`, the run's first guess) fails.

cases.origin: corpus external-v2 (real repository, upstream fix commit known)
cases.why: Locate a defect in a real repository from its symptom; the answer must name the file and function the upstream fix changed, and no invented symbol.
